name: Disneyland Galactic Grill & Red Rose Taverne Allergy-Friendly Gluten/Dairy-Free Chicken Tenders & Fries
brandOrRestaurant: Galactic Grill & Red Rose Taverne (Tomorrowland / Fantasyland · Disneyland Park)
searchKeywords: dairy free chicken tenders galactic grill
whyItWorks: Made with a light rice/corn-flour coating in a dedicated fryer with 0g dairy and 0g wheat—often lighter and less greasy than standard heavy wheat-breaded tenders.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Select from the **Gluten-Friendly** or **Milk-Allergy-Friendly** section at the bottom of the Galactic Grill or Red Rose Taverne mobile order menu.
watchOuts: Allow 5–8 extra minutes for the kitchen to cook allergy-friendly tenders fresh to order
